text: We evaluated a contrastive-consistency probe on the strong model's hidden states, read out at probe layer 12, in a weak-to-strong setting with gpt2-medium as the weak supervisor and qwen2.5-3b as the strong student. Across num_seeds = 4 seeds, the probe reached a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.90 with a standard error of 0.05, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.16. The margin over the baseline exceeds two standard errors of the PGR estimate, so the probe recovers a substantially larger share of the gap than naive weak supervision. Transfer accuracy was 0.71 (SE 0.01), situated between the weak supervisor's 0.53 and the strong model's ceiling of 0.73. Caveats: with only four seeds, the variance estimates are coarse and the finding should be treated as preliminary; results come from a single model pair, a single probe layer, and no sweep over layers or alternative weak supervisors is reported here.
